label: Fiore Sardo
note: Raw milk, no starter added; named for the old wooden moulds carved with a flower. Raw-milk, uncooked curd (curd broken to millet-grain size, not cooked); firm from long ripening, grated after 6 months.

about.text: Fiore Sardo is a hard Sardinian sheep cheese with PDO status, made from raw milk of Sarda ewes set with lamb or kid rennet paste. Wheels are double truncated cones of 1.5 to 4 kg, a table cheese that becomes a grating cheese after six months.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: About 10 log cfu/g mesophiles at 48 h falling to about 3 log cfu/g at 9 months; coliforms and staphylococci peak at 48 h then fall
